item.title: Federal judges in Colorado are fed up with ICE re-arresting the same immigrants
item.description: A federal judge in Colorado has found ICE in contempt for ignoring court orders to not immediately re-arrest detainees they've ordered released.

item.title: California Democrat Rep. Gomez resigns following ethics report on sexual misconduct allegations
item.description: California Congressman Rep. Jimmy Gomez says he will resign after a House Ethics report concluded Gomez's actions violated House rules by "making unwelcome sexual advances."

item.title: Ex-White House AI advisor weighs in on national security as Huang is back as Nvidia CEO
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is back in leadership after resigning recently. Ben Buchanan, a Biden administration AI adviser, discusses what that means for the U.S. national security and chip exports.

item.title: Some women in tech have concerns about Huang's return
